Dear Ted,

How effective is your organization at building and managing applications? Download these papers and find out how to address key challenges related
		to application development and management. Get these papers today!
The Evolution of Build and Release Management for Effective Software Delivery  
The Four Requirements of Next Generation Web Performance Management 
Federating SharePoint Sites within WebSphere Portal   

The Evolution of Build and Release Management for Effective Software Delivery
 		
		This Hurwitz and Associates paper presents the current development trends that are driving the need for better build and release management practices.
		This report shares in-depth case studies to explain how companies can address these development challenges in order to create measurable results in their 
		organizations. [Download the research now!]
The Four Requirements of Next Generation Web Performance Management
		Web applications are more complex than legacy client server or mainframe applications, due to new technologies like J2EE, .NET, SaaS, AJAX, SOA, Flash 
		and others. This paper discusses the challenges inherent in these new applications, and outlines the four requirements to effectively manage their performance. 
		[Get this white paper now.]
Federating SharePoint Sites within WebSphere Portal 
		This white paper explores the capabilities and architecture of Mainsoft's SharePoint Federator for WebSphere Portal. Composite 
		applications, single sign-on, and authentication schemes across .NET and Java are examined in detail. 
		[Get the paper today.]
For additional resources, visit our Tech Library. With our broad selection,  
		you're sure to find something of interest to you.
Sincerely,
Application Development Trends
